description: Installable single-DGX Spark image-to-3D Candidate using the pinned official Pixal3D source, local DINOv3 and NAF feature stack, bounded manual camera calibration, ARM64-native extensions, and deterministic GLB adapter. Its pinned nvdiffrast runtime dependency is limited to non-commercial research or evaluation; operator acceptance and physical Spark quality, memory, and latency evidence are still required. Excludes Trimesh WebP alignment bytes from image views before strict artifact validation.
title: Pixal3D native single Spark
